assertions.description: MajorMUD SYSOP authorization is closed at the native owner boundary. The supplied WCCMMUD.INI explicitly provides all 21 recognized SYS access settings; WCCMMUD!_cmd_sysop dispatches access checks through the Worldgroup _haskey import at the recovered callsites. MajorMUD owns command-to-setting selection and configured access-class strings; Worldgroup owns access-class membership/inheritance. Reforged maps that host-owned boundary to authenticated roles/capabilities and does not expose plaintext legacy-key authentication.

Classic MajorMUD has no native in-game world-content builder. Original WCCMMUD.DLL exposes 78 unique _cmd_ command handlers with no room/item/NPC/world editor root, while the retained exhaustive 20-root SYSOP catalog contains administration/configuration controls but no world-content editor. Character stat/description editors and bulletin/INI editors are not world-content builders. Reforged Creator Studio/Nightmare-style editing therefore remains an explicit Reforged extension rather than a Classic parity requirement.

Direct WCCMMUD.DLL disassembly resolves the apparent cross-category ambiguity negatively: Classic has no one universal race/class -> ability -> equipment -> aura/status pipeline. Modifier ordering is owned by each formula. _update_dynamic_stats has its own explicit traversal (character dynamic abilities, equipped-object abilities, class abilities, race abilities, further object-reference groups, then deferred ability 0x7C), while combat, secondary stats, status clocks, and creation retain their separately recovered owner-local order.

Native WCCMMUD _check_kill_user is exact: death starts on map 1, Evil Points below 40 select room 2189 and Evil Points 40 or higher select room 142; a nonzero current-room DeathRoom overrides the room and uses the current map. Reputation labels are not consulted. The live Classic death path now applies that exact branch and revives non-final deaths immediately.

Native WCCMMUD death-floor placement is now connected end-to-end. _add_item_to_room at 0x0041D0A1 proves 17 visible and 15 hidden room slots; incoming ItemUses == -1 stacks into the first same-item slot by incrementing native QTY (extra copies beyond the first) before empty-slot allocation, while finite-use copies require a new slot. _dispose_of_item_in_room attempts visible insertion twice, then performs bounded depth-first traversal through native exit order N,S,E,W,NE,NW,SE,SW,U,D, skips RoomType 8 ChangeMap and 12 RemoteAction, and permits origin through depth 5. _dispose_of_item_in_trail scans the per-session 20-entry newest-first movement trail with visible then hidden placement. The 100-slot inventory death loop finally retries map 1 room 164 through the same DFS and loses the item only if that fails; the 50-slot secondary loop has no room-164 fallback. Reforged mirrors the slot/QTY contract, movement trail, traversal, fallback split, and one-copy native room-QTY pickup behavior with executable DLL regression verification.

Native WCCMMUD proves ordinary non-final death preserves experience exactly. Final-death/REROLL retention is executable: when global KEEPEXP and the player SET KEEP option are enabled and level is above 1, the replacement character retains the greater of floor(total XP/10) and the stock threshold for floor(level/2) plus one; otherwise it starts at zero. REROLL creates a fresh replacement character and does not copy old character state beyond this retained experience.

Decoded race/class EXP percentages define the character progression chart used to calculate total experience required for each level. They are not multipliers on XP earned from monsters, quests, scripts, or other rewards.

Classic HP regeneration is native-verified: passive HP uses max(1,trunc(((Level+20)*Health)/750)); REST multiplies that base by three; signed HPRegen uses trunc(((100+modifier)*base)/100). Passive regeneration is owned by the 30-fast-tick slow character update and the executable regressions match the DLL.

Successful native TRAIN adds five lives and clamps the result to 9. WCCMMUD initializes the promotion-life increment global to 5, adds it after the level/HP/CP work, clamps at 9, and reports the actual delta. Reforged promotion now uses the same +5/cap-9 owner with regression vectors.
A normal Classic death costs exactly one life; native SUICIDE help states that suicide has the same effects as normal death and costs one life.
Classic characters start with 9 lives and 9 is the maximum lives value.

Native WCCMMUD computes Magic Resistance as signed Fix((INT + WIL*3)/4) and then adds the recovered modifier output. The live character formula and regression vectors match the original DLL weighting and ordering.

Classic mana regeneration is native-verified: magic types 1-4 use INT/WIL/trunc((INT+WIL)/2)/CHA with the Level/MagicLevel /1650 base; type 5 forces base 1. Passive regeneration applies signed MPRegen with native combined integer arithmetic; MEDITATE bypasses MPRegen, including type 5, and clamps mana to 0..maximum.
Native-traced character Max HP creation formula, including duplicate constitution adjustment, class/race terms, accumulated HP roll pool, and MaxHP modifier, is executable.
Native-traced Max Mana/Kai semantics are executable: nonmagic 0, magic types 1-4 use MagicLevel*Level*2 + 6 plus explicit modifiers/cache, and type 5 uses Level-1.

Modifier projection order is exact at the Classic ownership boundary: projections are owner-local rather than stages in a universal pipeline. Existing de-duplication remains at each consuming owner, and direct native _update_dynamic_stats supplies the recovered dynamic-stat traversal/deferred-0x7C order without imposing it on unrelated combat/secondary/status formulas.

Classic character departure/death lifecycle is native-exact for the MajorMUD-owned boundary. Shared _cleanup_when_user_leaves order is kill autocombat against user, stop dragging, stop following/group membership (leader departure detaches all followers and dissolves the party with no successor), clear gang invitations, dismiss native marker-37 angel summons, clear pending commands, then kill the user autocombat. Death invokes that owner before status termination/inventory/life/respawn. Graceful Worldgroup logoff is forget-list cleanup -> shared cleanup -> one save -> clear player/session. Unexpected hangup is preliminary save -> configured hangup consequence decision -> shared cleanup -> final save -> clear; retained stock defaults are NONE/0/0/0, so the default path applies no hangup penalty. Reforged now routes telnet, local console, headless sessions, PvP/ordinary death and practice-arena death through those recovered owners, while non-native generic pets/mercenary/charm behaviors remain separately evidence-gated.
When no lives remain, the Classic character dies permanently and cannot be used again.

Native WCCMMUD gates stock Picklocks on ability 37, applies the post-15 half-level adjustment, computes ((adjustedLevel*10 + AGL + INT)*2)/7, composes the paired native modifier output (ability 180), and clamps at zero. The separate CHA-bearing ability-40 branch is not the stock Picklocks owner.
One-level promotion applies proven HP roll/constitution growth and native mana growth by magic type.

Original WCCMMUD.DLL `_move_player_to_fighter` directly constructs raw player Dodge in fighter +0x20 by calling `_get_user_ability_value` for ability 34, then adding trunc(Level/5), trunc((Charm-50)/5), and trunc((Agility-50)/3). For living characters below 33% encumbrance it then adds `10-trunc(encumbrancePercent/10)`. `_calculate_attack` consumes that exact fighter field for the proven Dodge-vs-Accuracy, 95% cap, and Backstab /5 behavior. Reforged matches the native signed/truncating arithmetic and ordering.

Verified modified Stealth builder uses level, AGI, INT, Charm, class/race ownership adjustments, and Ability 27.

Its (raw+100)*10 base, multiplier/divisor table, high-level bands, 32-bit rollover handling, and billion tabulation match the live Reforged absolute-threshold formula and regression vectors.

Stock v1.11n+ capacity above STR 100 uses 4800 + (STR-100)*84.
Captured 23/26/43/53/60/100 percent examples reproduce native Light/Medium/Heavy bands.
Positive decoded Encumbrance modifier increases maximum carrying capacity.

Exact st token routes to native STATUS/SCORE.

Native WCCMMUD.DLL `_calculate_attack` directly proves attack-type pre-DR modifiers, hit, critical range, damage roll, DR subtraction, Bash/Smash post-DR multiplication, Dodge (including Backstab /5), and final clamp ordering; the live resolver now follows that exact order.
Quick & Deadly uses recovered attack-energy, Agility, 20-point cap, and encumbrance-halving behavior.
Stock MajorMUD physical combat advances on a five-second round and the authoritative host combat scheduler now uses 5000 ms.

Reforged 0352 preserves NPC/opponent attack ownership, supports per-character PvP BREAK/re-engagement, and keeps Borin/client incoming-danger state separate from local autocombat.
A learned spell short name can be issued directly and dispatches to the cast path before contextual room actions.
GREET owns the NPC conversation entry point while ASK remains the keyword/query path.

Original WCCMMUD.DLL _buy_item directly consumes the current/effective Charm WORD at character +0xAC and applies factor 110-floor(Charm/5) after the shop Markup+100 integer stage, with native truncation at each divide and the recovered >100000 scale/restore behavior. Cross-category construction of effective Charm remains a separate character-modifier-order boundary.

Native WCCMMUD folds five money slots through x100, x100, x10, x10, proving stock low-to-high copper multipliers 1/10/100/10,000/1,000,000. BUY/SELL item cost_type callsites populate exactly one corresponding slot and live LIST/BUY/SELL use the same conversion.

Native ShopType-5 non-item service ownership is exact. BUY HEALING costs two copper per missing HP, checks funds before mutation, debits before setting current HP to maximum, and uses the native direct insufficient-funds string. BUY CURING and BUY CURE POISON share the curing branch: 15 silver when not poisoned and 25 silver when poisoned, debit before the poison-clear effect, with exact native success/failure strings. Decoded scripted healer PRICE/CAST/ADDDELAY service lines remain separately executable; ADDDELAY is already native-exact as the live delay byte and queued-command boundary.

Native BUY converts cost_type to copper, scales bases over 100,000 down by 100, applies integer floor(base*(Markup+100)/100), then integer floor(value*(110-floor(Charm/5))/100), and restores x100 when scaled. Charm 0 therefore uses 110%, and there is no VB final-rounding stage. Reforged now matches these native integer boundaries.

Native SELL converts cost_type to copper, ignores shop markup, and returns integer floor(base*(floor(Charm/2)+25)/100). Charm 0 therefore yields 25%. Reforged now matches the original DLL and regression vectors.

Original WCCMMUD.DLL _sell_item directly consumes the current/effective Charm WORD at character +0xAC and computes floor(baseCopper*(floor(Charm/2)+25)/100), including Charm 0 => 25%, with no shop markup and native integer truncation.

No blank, unknown, or unknown_service shop kind remains, and the audit fails closed on either unknown numeric service types or unknown semantic kinds.
Native BUY loads shop Markup, adds 100, multiplies the current base value, and integer-divides by 100. Raw 0 is retail and raw 100 is +100%; the live pricing owner matches this exact native stage.

Reforged preflights the native affordability failure before mutation and wraps character plus persistent shop-stock mutation in a per-shop serialized compensation boundary so exceptions restore both sides without overwriting a simultaneous buyer.

Route commands, fares, message IDs, destination map/room pairs, NPC summons, and the decoded 15/846 Khazarad-to-message-2578 mismatch are preserved literally.

The Classic Host global-world-state boundary is exact: all 156 MajorMUD-used Worldgroup symbols are owned, all 34 imported global/indirect symbols classify as host runtime/message transport rather than an unidentified gameplay-state store, and native persistence now maps WCCUSER2 as Player data plus the exact 11-family Buffer data set. This PASS means the inventory has no hidden/unowned native bucket; it deliberately does not promote owner-local formulas, messages, limits, branch order or other STRONG semantics.

Classic save coordination is native-exact at the MajorMUD/Worldgroup boundary. _background_other schedules Player data every 60 seconds through _save_characters/WCCUSER2, while _background_save_buffers schedules 300-second Buffer cycles progressed record-by-record through _save_next_buffer. The exact 11 Buffer families and both rotating/full-flush orders are mapped. The supplied WGSERV archive's WCC artifact set is exactly inventoried and classified: 3,605 non-directory files include 155 WCC-prefixed files across the retained DAT/VIR/HSE/CV_/DLL/EXE/config/document/support families. The existing WCC exhaustion audit classifies every supplied family; post-WCC native questions are explicitly reassigned to Worldgroup/native-runtime owners rather than left in an unclassified WCC bucket.

Classic capacity/resource ownership is now exact at the MajorMUD boundary. Direct native owners prove 100 carried root inventory slots, 50 secondary item slots, 17 visible plus 15 hidden room-item slots, exact room/death overflow disposal, and six total party users (leader/self plus five native slots), alongside already-recovered lives/name/encumbrance limits. External startup configuration ranges not consumed by recovered gameplay formulas are not invented as live Classic rules.

Classic error/recovery ownership is exact at the global MajorMUD boundary. Ordinary rejected gameplay actions are state-preserving no-ops and do not request rollback, disable a subsystem, stop world load, or force disconnect merely because the action failed. Wrong-version/wrong-identity/corrupt native files remain hard startup/load failures. Command/action failure text versus silence and post-startup record/reference handling are owner-local native branches, not a universal recovery renderer or crash policy, so the broad layer deliberately does not synthesize one. CodeUpdate0361 closes catastrophic persistence semantics: WCCMMUD imports record mutation calls but no begin/end/abort transaction functions, so saves are synchronous record-level/best-effort operations and earlier successful records are not rolled back through a WCC-selected transaction when a later save fails. Reforged generic rollback/disable/default helpers and Worldgroup/MKDE crash replay remain explicit non-Classic implementation/host boundaries.

Classic MajorMUD has no in-game native import/export/migration subsystem to emulate. Content is edited externally (for example in Nightmare Redux), then the exact expected native file at the exact matching version is copied into the MajorMUD installation and the server is started/restarted. Wrong/corrupt files or version mismatches are hard startup/load failures rather than conversion paths. Exact crash/log text and binary header encoding are not required to invent a migration layer; Reforged Classic rejects migration/import/export requests and validates exact version/file identity.

Inventory emits native carrying, keys, wealth, encumbrance sequence.

Original WCCMMUD stores exactly five physical monster attack rows. The decoded attack_count is retained only as a projection-integrity count of executable rows and is not read as a native cadence/storage controller; the native dispatcher still performs the separately proven six selection attempts when executable rows exist.

Original WCCMMUD.DLL _monster_cast proves Type-2 AttAcc is spell id, AttMin is cast-success percent, AttMax is cast level, and AttEnergy is the energy requirement/cost; cast success uses a separate native [0,100) roll with roll < AttMin.

Native spell-energy ownership is fully separated. Insufficient energy debits nothing; a Type-2 pre-cast failure charges max(1,floor(AttEnergy/2)) for positive costs; after a successful pre-cast that paid full energy, a later rejected/no-effect single-target cast restores the full cost for net zero; committed effects retain the full cost.

Classic NPC HPRegen is owned by the native slow monster generation. An admitted slow generation is cursor-pumped one active monster slot at a time by the host loop; each eligible NPC receives its authored HPRegen once for that generation, capped at maximum. Pending generations are capped at one rather than stacked.

Classic monster records use a recovered mixed-width legacy layout: key combat/behavior fields are signed 16-bit integers, attack type/selection fields are bytes, and record ids/message pointers/experience/currency are 32-bit longs. Runtime now validates decoded Classic NPC records against those native widths without globally forcing all arithmetic to Int16.

Native WCCMMUD _cast_monster_target proves ability 146 (MonsGuards) is ordered same-room spell-target substitution. Each value is a guard monster legacy id; the requested target ability slots are scanned in authored order and the room native monster slots are scanned in slot order, substituting the first matching live guard. It is not physical ATTACK blocking or generic combat assist propagation.

Classic autonomous NPC AI is now bounded by the recovered fast/medium/slow/energy lanes and movement/tracking owners. Generic Reforged threat scores, perception-radius aggro, low-HP flee and patrol-path policies are not present in those native lanes and remain extensions. Medium movement has the native three-attempt generation cap, Follow probability, confusion ability 71 and recovered type table; fast behavior is followed-user tracking with retry limit 15.

Message 8480 is a native physical dodge/miss template. The original WCCMMUD 1.11p DLL and wccknms2.dat trace proves that npc.1006 Nahr has equipped-item ID 0; _move_monster_to_fighter therefore NULs both caller-owned attack-verb and weapon-name buffers, and _attack_monster_user passes those exact empty strings to all five message-8480 calls. Runtime preserves the resulting native empty spacing instead of substituting modern prose.
